استصححن (form X)
# اِسْتَصْحَحْنَ (istaṣḥaḥna) /is.tasˤ.ħaħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# اِسْتَصْحِحْنَ (istaṣḥiḥna) /is.tasˤ.ħiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
